status: FROZEN STATIC ENGINEERING RECOMMENDATION; NOT EXECUTED
coverage_assessment: Assess incremental intended core mechanisms and native families; overlapping full-attention blocks do not double-count Next as an independent ordinary-MoE substitute. No invented weighted score.

ordering_decisions.coverage: At the initial baseline every owner adds a core primitive and native wrapper; no performance score or survivor count distinguishes them.
ordering_decisions.adaptation_testability: Native BF16 ordinary attention on Qwen30 avoids Devstral original-FP8 reconstruction/scale/alias and multimodal-key validation at the first baseline.
ordering_decisions.verification_burden: Use established single-sequence full-attention baseline before adding a conversion and different serializer; Qwen30 runtime source lock is an explicit pre-execution gate.
ordering_decisions.resource_burden: Devstral BF16 is smaller, but resources are a later tiebreak and do not override the earlier conversion/testability distinction.

ordering_decisions.coverage: Both add an unrepresented mechanism and serialization after Qwen; dense and MLA are both retained.
ordering_decisions.adaptation_testability: Ordinary dense q/k/v/o and MLP module forwards precede compressed/low-rank attention and expert tensor packing.
ordering_decisions.verification_burden: Resolve Devstral own-original reconstruction explicitly, then add MLA kernel/cache/export validation; no source-supported path is discarded.
ordering_decisions.resource_burden: Devstral reconstructed base ~44.725 GiB versus GLM main ~55.774 GiB supports this engineering sequence; neither estimate is a fit guarantee.

ordering_decisions.coverage: MLA and Mamba each add a new core mechanism and native default-thinking wrapper; both retained.
ordering_decisions.adaptation_testability: Ordinary MLA projection adapter flow precedes reference Mamba scan/dispatch and wrapper-bypass restrictions.
ordering_decisions.verification_burden: Mamba needs SSM/conv/KV reset plus known dt-clamp parity and kernel warmup/reset verification in addition to full suffix checks.
ordering_decisions.resource_burden: Comparable base residency; recurrent backward/workspace uncertainty, rather than active parameter count, is recorded.

ordering_decisions.coverage: Mamba and DeltaNet are independent; Nemotron additionally introduces a serializer not yet checked, while Next shares the already checked Qwen family.
ordering_decisions.adaptation_testability: Next requires separately verified full/linear projection branches and distributed same-original adaptation; no Next pass is inherited.
ordering_decisions.verification_burden: Defer Next sharded load/reset/adapter/export until smaller configurations establish baseline governance/transport; preserve Qwen30 before Next.
ordering_decisions.resource_burden: Next ~148.405 GiB BF16 tensor payload and multi-GPU planning exceeds Nemotron ~58.819 GiB main payload. No hardware ceiling or quality exclusion.

previous_absolute_adjacency_not_required: Earlier order compared only the two Qwens; completed independent gap representatives now occur between them.
tie_policy: No candidate removed to impose a model count. Retain both on a genuine tie; sequence is a methodological staging recommendation, not a proof of a unique optimal order.

minimum_required_path.scope: Native original BF16, conservative attention LoRA, entire raw suffix, full context/control/terminal/isolation/repeat/resource gates, save/reload/serve-or-merge and second fresh ORIGINAL cycle
minimum_required_path.source_lock_before_any_execution: Resolve vLLM 0.11.2 immutable source/build against archived hashes; no silent replacement with 0.16.0/0.30.0

extended_mechanism_coverage_path.scope: Independent conservative lifecycle per non-redundant configuration, plus only those hybrid/MLP/expert gates required for the particular intended claim

conditional_scope_claims.stacked_expert: GLM Q or Nemotron S plus their scope-dependent lifecycle/export/resource checks
conditional_scope_claims.ordinary_expert: Separately declared Qwen expert scope-specific checks; not automatically included in historical A–S
